paper.title: Flash-VStream: Memory-Based Real-Time Understanding for Long Video Streams

latest_version.version_label: arXiv current version of the benchmark-introducing paper

evidence.paraphrase: VStream-QA is introduced for asynchronous question answering over continuously arriving long video streams rather than explicit memory-management diagnosis.

adjudication_notes: Retained because Table 1 marks it as memory-adjacent; it should be separable from core-memory benchmark counts.
